content:
Human evaluation involves having human judges assess the quality of text generated by a language model based on certain criteria. This process helps in evaluating the performance of the language model. 

For instance, imagine you are designing an AI-powered chatbot that should understand and respond to simple questions. A group of people would review the responses provided by the chatbot and rate them based on how well they match the expected answers. If most of the reviewers agree that the chatbot's responses are clear, relevant, and easy to understand, it could be a sign that the model is performing well.
